sections.text_helper: Section 2.1.5 "Bus matrix" in chapter 2 (Memory and bus architecture), RM0522 Rev 1, page 89.
sections.section_content:
The bus matrix manages the access arbitration between masters. The arbitration uses a
Round-Robin algorithm. This bus matrix features a fast bus multiplexer used to connect
each master to a given slave without latency (see Figure1). For the same master, other
slaves undergo a latency of at least one cycle at each new access.
